basic_details.job_title: DC Hojai Administrative Officer Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: The Office of the District Commissioner, Hojai Sankardev Nagar (Government of Assam) has invited applications for the post of Administrative Officer in the amalgamated establishment of the District Commissioner, Hojai. The post is open to employees who have served at least 15 years in any District Commissioner's establishment in Assam. Applications must be submitted through proper channel and must reach the office of the District Commissioner, Hojai on or before 07 December 2026; no application will be entertained after that date.

qualification.details: Service: The applicant must have served at least 15 (Fifteen) years in any of the District Commissioner's establishment in Assam. Experience: The applicant must have experience in different branches in general and in the establishment branch in particular, as per the Assam Ministerial District Establishment Service (Amendment) Rules, 2009, as amended, and must fulfil the eligibility conditions under those Rules. Educational qualification: Graduate degree in any discipline from a recognized university in India. Age: The application must state the applicant's age, but the notice does not mention an age limit. Pay: Pay Band-3 of ₹22,000-97,000/- with Grade Pay of ₹11,500/- per month, plus other allowances as admissible under the Assam Services (ROP) Rules, 2017, as amended from time to time, and the Assam Ministerial District Establishment Service Rules, 1967, as amended. | Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions under the Assam Ministerial District Establishment Service (Amendment) Rules, 2009.

selection_process: Selection shall be made by the Government in the General Administration Department in accordance with the provisions of the Assam Ministerial District Establishment Service Rules
and the Assam Ministerial District Establishment Service (Amendment) Rules
as amended. The notice does not mention a written test or an interview.

content_sections.heading: DC Hojai Administrative Officer at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the number of vacancies, the age limit or the application fee.

rows.details: Office of the District Commissioner, Hojai Sankardev Nagar (Personnel Branch), Government of Assam
Pay Band-3 of ₹22,000-97,000/- with Grade Pay of ₹11,500/- per month, plus admissible allowances
Graduate degree in any discipline from a recognized university in India, with at least 15 years of service in a District Commissioner's establishment in Assam
Amalgamated establishment of the District Commissioner, Hojai

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: The application must be prepared in the prescribed format and submitted through proper channel, along with complete service particulars, to the office of the District Commissioner, Hojai Sankardev Nagar. The notice does not print a separate postal address with PIN code or an envelope superscription. Write the application in the prescribed format, stating your age, educational qualification, present and permanent address, and experience in different branches. Attach attested copies of certificates/documents, one recent passport-size photograph and the Annual Confidential Reports (ACRs) for the last 5 (five) consecutive years. Add complete service particulars. Submit the application through proper channel to the office of the District Commissioner, Hojai. Ensure it reaches the office on or before 07 December 2026; no application shall be entertained after that date.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Service: The applicant must have served at least 15 (Fifteen) years in any of the District Commissioner's establishment in Assam. Experience: The applicant must have experience in different branches in general and in the establishment branch in particular, as per the Assam Ministerial District Establishment Service (Amendment) Rules, 2009, as amended, and must fulfil the eligibility conditions under those Rules. Educational qualification: Graduate degree in any discipline from a recognized university in India. Age: The application must state the applicant's age, but the notice does not mention an age limit. Pay: Pay Band-3 of ₹22,000-97,000/- with Grade Pay of ₹11,500/- per month, plus other allowances as admissible under the Assam Services (ROP) Rules, 2017, as amended from time to time, and the Assam Ministerial District Establishment Service Rules, 1967, as amended. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions under the Assam Ministerial District Establishment Service (Amendment) Rules, 2009.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Attested copies of certificates/documents supporting age, educational qualification, address and experience One recent passport-size photograph Annual Confidential Reports (ACRs) for the last 5 (five) consecutive years Complete service particulars

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection shall be made by the Government in the General Administration Department in accordance with the provisions of the Assam Ministerial District Establishment Service Rules, 1967, and the Assam Ministerial District Establishment Service (Amendment) Rules, 2009, as amended. The notice does not mention a written test or an interview.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date for the DC Hojai Administrative Officer application?
faq.answer: The application must reach the office of the District Commissioner, Hojai on or before 07 December 2026, and no application will be entertained after that date.

faq.question: Q2. What qualification is needed for the DC Hojai Administrative Officer post?
faq.answer: The applicant must hold a graduate degree in any discipline from a recognized university in India.

faq.question: Q3. How many years of service are required?
faq.answer: The applicant must have served at least 15 (Fifteen) years in any District Commissioner's establishment in Assam, with experience in different branches and in the establishment branch in particular.

faq.question: Q4. What is the pay for the DC Hojai Administrative Officer post?
faq.answer: The post carries Pay Band-3 of ₹22,000-97,000/- with Grade Pay of ₹11,500/- per month, plus other allowances as admissible under the Assam Services (ROP) Rules, 2017 and the Assam Ministerial District Establishment Service Rules, 1967.

faq.question: Q5. How do I apply for the DC Hojai Administrative Officer post?
faq.answer: Submit the application in the prescribed format through proper channel, with complete service particulars, to the office of the District Commissioner, Hojai by 07 December 2026.

faq.question: Q6. Which documents must be attached to the application?
faq.answer: Attach attested copies of certificates/documents, one recent passport-size photograph and the Annual Confidential Reports (ACRs) for the last 5 (five) consecutive years.

faq.question: Q7. What details must the application state?
faq.answer: The application must state the applicant's age, educational qualification, present and permanent address, and experience in different branches.

faq.question: Q8. Who selects the Administrative Officer?
faq.answer: Selection is made by the Government in the General Administration Department under the Assam Ministerial District Establishment Service Rules, 1967 and the Assam Ministerial District Establishment Service (Amendment) Rules, 2009, as amended.
